# Media timeline (`media-timeline`)

Tracks, clips, ruler, playhead, snapping and zoom.

Group: Media & editors. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/media';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createMediaTimeline` (types in `dist/web/media/mediaTimeline.d.ts`): `mountMediaTimeline` on a new `<div>`.

```ts
export function createMediaTimeline(options: MediaTimelineOptions): MediaTimelineHandle;

export interface MediaTimelineOptions {
  /** Accessible name ("Timeline"). */
  label: string;
  /** Seconds. */
  duration: number;
  tracks: readonly TimelineTrack[];
  /** Playhead, seconds. */
  position?: number;
  /** Pixels per second (default 48). */
  zoom?: number;
  minZoom?: number;
  maxZoom?: number;
  /** Frames per second: timecodes gain frames and keys step by a frame. */
  fps?: number;
  /** Snap to clip edges, the playhead and the grid while dragging (default true). */
  snap?: boolean;
  /** Grid for snapping and key steps, seconds; default the ruler's small tick (or one frame with `fps`). */
  snapStep?: number;
  selected?: string | null;
  /** Scroll to keep the playhead in view when `setPosition` moves it (default true). */
  follow?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<MediaTimelineLabels>;
  onSeek?: (position: number) => void;
  onSelect?: (clipId: string | null) => void;
  /** A clip moved or was trimmed; `committed` once the drag ends (key presses commit at once). */
  onClipChange?: (change: TimelineClipChange, committed: boolean) => void;
  /** Ctrl or ⌘ + wheel (or a trackpad pinch) changed the zoom. */
  onZoomChange?: (zoom: number) => void;
}

export interface MediaTimelineHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setPosition(position: number): void;
  setZoom(zoom: number): void;
  setTracks(tracks: readonly TimelineTrack[]): void;
  setSelected(clipId: string | null): void;
  setSnap(snap: boolean): void;
  getTracks(): TimelineTrack[];
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface MediaTimelineLabels {
  playhead: string;
  hint: string;
  locked: string;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

`formatTimecode` (types in `dist/web/media/timecode.d.ts`): `1:05`, `1:02:05`, `00:01:05:12` (with `fps`). Negative times get a minus sign; non-finite ones read as zero. Frames are counted down (a frame is shown once it has fully begun).

```ts
export function formatTimecode(seconds: number, options: TimecodeOptions = {}): string;

export interface TimecodeOptions {
  /** Frames per second: adds a frame field (`HH:MM:SS:FF`, always with hours). */
  fps?: number;
  /** Always show hours (`0:01:05`). */
  hours?: boolean;
  /** Digits after the seconds (`1:05.25`); ignored with `fps`. */
  decimals?: number;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createMediaTimeline, createText, formatTimecode, type TimelineTrack } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const tracks: TimelineTrack[] = [
  {
    id: 'video',
    name: 'Video',
    icon: 'film',
    clips: [
      { id: 'garden', start: 0, end: 7.5, label: 'Morning garden' },
      { id: 'kitchen', start: 7.5, end: 15, label: 'Kitchen', tone: 2 },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'titles', name: 'Titles', clips: [{ id: 'title', start: 1, end: 5, label: 'Our week', tone: 5 }] },
  { id: 'music', name: 'Music', icon: 'music', locked: true, clips: [{ id: 'song', start: 0, end: 20, label: 'Quiet Harbour', tone: 4 }] },
];

const status = createText('Drag clips to move them, their edges to trim.', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const timeline = createMediaTimeline({
  label: 'Edit timeline',
  duration: 20,
  tracks,
  zoom: 40,
  onSeek: (t) => (status.textContent = `Playhead at ${formatTimecode(t, { decimals: 1 })}`),
  onClipChange: (change, committed) => {
    if (committed) status.textContent = `${change.clipId}: ${formatTimecode(change.start)} to ${formatTimecode(change.end)}`;
  },
});

document.body.append(timeline.el, status);
```

## React API

`MediaTimeline` (types in `dist/react/media-editors.d.ts`): Builds `mountMediaTimeline` into a `<div>` it renders; same DOM and classes once mounted. `position`, `zoom`,`tracks`, `selected` and `snap` props update it in place; the duration, frame rate and limits rebuild it.

```ts
export function MediaTimeline({ label, duration, tracks, position = 0, zoom = 48, minZoom, maxZoom, fps, snap = true, snapStep, selected = null, follow, labels, className, ...callbacks }: MediaTimelineProps);

export interface MediaTimelineProps {
  label: string;
  duration: number;
  tracks: readonly TimelineTrack[];
  position?: number;
  zoom?: number;
  minZoom?: number;
  maxZoom?: number;
  fps?: number;
  snap?: boolean;
  snapStep?: number;
  selected?: string | null;
  follow?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<MediaTimelineLabels>;
  onSeek?: (position: number) => void;
  onSelect?: (clipId: string | null) => void;
  onClipChange?: (change: TimelineClipChange, committed: boolean) => void;
  onZoomChange?: (zoom: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MediaTimeline } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { TimelineClipChange, TimelineTrack } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const TRACKS: TimelineTrack[] = [
  {
    id: 'video',
    name: 'Video',
    icon: 'film',
    clips: [
      { id: 'garden', start: 0, end: 7.5, label: 'Morning garden' },
      { id: 'kitchen', start: 7.5, end: 15, label: 'Kitchen', tone: 2 },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'titles', name: 'Titles', clips: [{ id: 'title', start: 1, end: 5, label: 'Our week', tone: 5 }] },
  { id: 'music', name: 'Music', icon: 'music', locked: true, clips: [{ id: 'song', start: 0, end: 20, label: 'Quiet Harbour', tone: 4 }] },
];

const applyChange = (tracks: TimelineTrack[], { clipId, start, end }: TimelineClipChange) =>
  tracks.map((track) => ({ ...track, clips: track.clips.map((c) => (c.id === clipId ? { ...c, start, end } : c)) }));

export function MediaTimelineExample() {
  const [tracks, setTracks] = useState(TRACKS);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState(0);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  return (
    <MediaTimeline
      label="Edit timeline"
      duration={20}
      tracks={tracks}
      position={position}
      selected={selected}
      zoom={40}
      onSeek={setPosition}
      onSelect={setSelected}
      onClipChange={(change, committed) => committed && setTracks((list) => applyChange(list, change))}
    />
  );
}
```
